title: The Boran Family
wikitext: {{Questbox | name=The Boran Family | start=[[Arnold Boran]] | faction=Alliance | id= | level=51 | category=Lapidis Isle | reputation = +100 [[Kul Tiras (faction)|Kul Tiras]] | experience = 4650 | rewards = 80s }} == Objectives == Deliver the letters from Arnold Boran to his two brothers. * Deliver [[Letter to Karl]]: 0/1 * Deliver [[Letter to Samual]]: 0/1 * [[Letter from Karl]]: 0/1 * [[Letter from Samual]]: 0/1 == Description == I come from a large family, one that once occupied the boroughs of Kul Tiras. We weren't exactly a rich family, but we were not poor either! I traveled out with two of my brothers when the third war started up in Lordaeron, hoping to earn some fortune and glory. I helped the navy, my brother Karl started work in Menethil Harbor, and Samual went to Southshore to assist the war effort. Ever since I set sail years ago, I have had no communication with them and would like to reach out, if you could deliver a letter to the both of them. They must have thought I perished after so long without a word or peep, and I want to ease their minds. ==Rewards== * 80s * 4650 [[XP]] == Progress == Have you seen my brothers yet? It will require travelling, but I would appreciate it greatly. == Completion == My family has always been close knit, and I know that such a long length without hearing from me would certainly cause worry. I am simply happy to dispell such concern and let them know all is fine. Thanks again. This has meant a lot for me. ==Notes== [[Karl Boran]] is located on the docks in [[Menethil Harbor]] in the [[Wetlands]], and [[Samual Boran]] is located in the inn in [[Southshore]], in the [[Hillsbrad Foothills]]. ;Speaking with Karl :{{gossip|''I have a letter from your brother.''}} :'''Karl Boran says:''' A letter from Arnold... I thought he died at sea. I haven't heard from him in such a long time. :'''Karl Boran says:''' This is splendid news. Here, please take this to him. ;Speaking with Samual :{{gossip|''I have a letter from your brother.''}} :'''Samual Boran says:''' I knew Arnold was still out there somewhere, though I cannot imagine what it would be like stranded on some island at sea. Hopefully he returns home safely. :'''Samual Boran says:''' I have a letter for you. Deliver it to him and with haste. {{DEFAULTSORT: Boran Family, The}}
